Tomato - Zucchini Stir Fry
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:35am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons butter or oil
1 sm. onion, sliced
1 clove garlic, mashed
1 teaspoon basil leaves
2 cups thin sliced zucchini
1 lg. tomato

Preparation

1 Put butter or oil in skillet, add sliced onion and garlic. Cook slightly. Add basil and zucchini. Cook until crisp tender. Remove from heat. Cut tomato into small wedges. Add to skillet. Cover and let stand 1 minute. Serve immediately.
